title: kbs init should set a unique project key and a complete gitignore
description: Every new board gets project_key kanbus and init has no option to choose one; about six of Ryan's repositories still use kanbus as their key. Realtime topics are keyed by project key, so boards sharing a key cross-talk on a shared MQTT broker. init also ignores only project/.overlay/, leaving project/.cache/ (written by kbsc) unignored and no decision recorded for project/events/. Proposal: init --key (defaulting to the directory name), console_port chosen automatically, and a gitignore block covering .cache and .overlay.
